name: A Greener Source
description: Zero-cost office furniture donations including desks, chairs, filing cabinets, and other office furnishings; free curbside delivery within 50 miles of the project site
fullDescription: A Greener Source is an office furniture decommissioning company that keeps unwanted furniture out of landfills by donating it at no cost to registered nonprofits, schools, churches, and charities.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free office desks and workstations
- Chairs (office, conference, guest)
- Filing cabinets and storage
- Conference tables
- Cubicle systems and panels
- Other office furnishings as available
- Free curbside delivery within 50 miles of the project site on the removal date
howToGetIt:
1. Register your nonprofit organization at agreenersource.com
2. Browse available furniture inventory online
3. Request items through the website (keep requesting if not approved at first)
4. Confirm approval and schedule delivery; have staff or volunteers on site to carry items inside
5. Overstock items at the Hayward warehouse can be picked up by appointment
keywords: free office furniture, nonprofit donation, desk, chair, filing cabinet, conference table, cubicle, workstation, sustainable, reuse, recycled furniture
